regressions.execution: All 32 suites passed in one full npm test run.

coveredBehavior: Two actual authenticated TCP clients exercise summary-only news listings, authorized detail photos and daily per-member article views
Private news audience checks and list/detail field separation prevent summary payloads exposing full text or original images
Large game photos and structured metadata arrive through signed response chunks and survive persistence import
The actual admin HTTP route accepts bounded image requests above the prior 128 KiB limit and rejects operator writes
Content image validation rejects SVG, URLs and invalid raster data; channels reject non-http/https protocols
Photo removal, metadata preservation on partial updates and failed-save rollback
Public member pages return the selected member while the separate viewer remains the requesting account; private wallet and installation fields are excluded
Another member follower/following lists, member block exclusion and report creation
Real Web Admin DOM/API forms save game metadata and photos, display and remove existing news photos
Light and inverted dark QR images decode at two scales with both filled and erased nine-module logo regions
All existing wallet, purchase, authentication, lifecycle, avatar refresh, support/bot persistence and Web UI suites
nativeSourceGuards: Home/news/game/feed/profile tab routing and service reset state agree
Profile photo replaces the last tab icon; separate viewer data respects profile revisions and is cleared on stop/destruction
All menu has no detail captions, retains search and opens Settings
Custom TEdit style supplies content/foreground/selection resources without platform background artwork
Text layout measurement sizes messages using actual text bounds rather than character counts
Reaction SVGs are clipped inside independent 22-unit icon containers with 56-unit controls and right-aligned comments
Grouped member information opens a public profile; own profile has follower/following icons and no balance card
Article badges/photos and detail-only timestamps/views; game channels and separate minimum/recommended collapsible sections
Loading skeleton and rotating icon stay outside replaceable data and do not intercept navigation
Icon-only pull refresh uses the existing lifecycle/cancel/timeout protections
QR foreground, background, quiet zone, logo and entry-screen colors follow the persisted theme

nativeCompilation.reason: Delphi compiler and Android device unavailable; original project files remain user-owned

limitations: Native edit presentation/IME, popup, text alignment, gesture and animation behavior require Delphi compilation and real-device verification.
Photos are administrator-managed news images and game banners; the member profile grid remains a text-post grid.
Public profile view totals aggregate visible post counters; article detail counts use one hit per member per UTC day.
QR tests decode generated raster images, not photographs of a physical screen.
APK and Relay/Web must be updated together.
